title: TCPCL: Reassemble with full 64-bit transfer ID
description:
The earlier TCPCL dissector merged in !4577 used the built-in fragment reassembly functions, which truncated the Transfer ID (used to correlate fragments) from the native `guint64` to the `guint32` used by the `addresses_reassembly_table_functions`. Also it should have included TCP port correlation of `addresses_ports_reassembly_table_functions` because Transfer IDs are unique only within a single TCP connection.

This issue was a carry-over from the original dtn-wireshark project from which the dissector was taken.
